name: 2C-B-aminorex
summary: 2C-B-aminorex (2C-B-AR) is a recreational designer drug with psychedelic and/or stimulant effects. It is a substituted aminorex derivative which was first identified in Sweden in June 2019. Structurally, it is a hybrid of 4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine (2C-B) and aminorex.
